text:
A black, E white, I red, U green, O blue: vowels,

one day I will tell your latent birth:

black furry corset of dazzling flies,

A, buzzing around atrocious stenches,


bays of shadow; E, candor of pavilions

and ships, proud ice, white kings, umbels

that tremble. I, spat blood, laughter of wrath

on a lovely lip, on a lip drunk with penitence;


U, cycles, divine vibrations, green seas,

peace of pastures sown with animals, of furrows

that alchemy has engraved on studious brows.


O, superhuman Trumpet pregnant with strange

stridencies and silences crossing Worlds and Angels:

O, Omega, violet glow of Her Eyes.

translation.title: Vowels
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the synesthetic vowel-color sequence and the climactic Omega.
